links.note: The sentence quoted in the stem is this concept's own - the farmers had to sell the milk quickly before it could spoil, a lot of effort for the small amount of money they would earn - which is the problem technology later solves. Already linked and correct.
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel advising the farmers to form a cooperative - this concept's opening.
AMUL set up in 1946 under Tribhuvandas Patel and Dr. Varghese Kurien - this concept names both.
Pasteurisation glossed as a process by which milk is preserved through heating to a specific temperature to kill harmful bacteria - this concept's gloss.
Recycling one tonne of paper saving 17 trees - this concept's DON'T MISS OUT figure.
Primary activities as those in which people are directly dependent on nature to produce goods - this concept's definition, which makes the statement true. Already linked and correct.
The tertiary sector also being called the service sector - this concept's closing sentence.
AMUL formed so that the farmers would become independent and stop relying on the middlemen - this concept's account, which is what makes the statement false.
Milking cows as primary and processing milk into butter as secondary - this concept's classification of the AMUL story. Already linked and correct.
Kautilya on the root of prosperity being economic activity, its lack bringing material distress and its absence endangering current prosperity and future growth - this concept's epigraph in full.

Why classifying activities helps - this concept says it helps us understand how they function and the links they have with each other. Already linked and correct. Note: the printed answer belongs to a different question, about banking as a tertiary activity.

Matching each primary activity to what it yields - grains and vegetables from farms, wood from forests, coal from mines, fish from fisheries - is this concept's list, and mining yields coal rather than electricity.

Identifying which activities are secondary rests on this concept's classification, milk converted into cheese and butter in factories being secondary while the selling is not. Already linked and correct; the item's other numbered statements are missing from the stem.
Sardar Patel advising a cooperative so the farmers could become independent and stop relying on the middlemen - this concept's reason. Already linked and correct.

The sentence quoted in the stem is this concept's own - the tasks were shared by everyone, which helped raise their income gradually, and they did not need the middlemen anymore and became like one big family. Already linked and correct.
The textbook process from pulp to printed book, which this concept says required all three sectors working together - so a break in the primary stage stops the rest. Already linked and correct.

Comparing work in the primary and secondary sectors - this concept draws the contrast concretely, milk taken directly from a natural source against milk converted into another form in factories. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
